extracted.name: Quick and Spicy Spaghetti Squash
extracted.description: This quick and easy recipe for spicy spaghetti squash shows you how to cook and shred spaghetti squash, so it looks like noodles.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Coat inside of squash with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Place squash cut-side down on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until squash is tender, about 30 minutes. Cool squash for 10 minutes.
Shred inside of squash with a fork and transfer to a bowl. Add remaining olive oil, parsley, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper to shredded squash and toss to coat.
